name: message-scroller
title: Message Scroller
description: Manga-styled wrapper around your shadcn Message Scroller (the scrolling column of a conversation with a 'jump to latest' button). The viewport keeps the stock behaviour (it scrolls) with a thin ink scrollbar and no grey fade at the edges. MessageScrollerButton is a square ink-framed button (only bubbles are round): it pops in when the reader scrolls up (animate-pop), lifts on hover, shows a focus ring and hits on click (impact lines). 44px touch target under 640px.
docs: Import from "@/components/ui/manga/message-scroller". It wraps your own components/ui/message-scroller, so Radix and Base UI both work: never pass render or asChild to MessageScrollerButton.

meta.tagline: A conversation column that jumps back to the latest line.
meta.usage:
import { MessageScrollerProvider, MessageScroller, MessageScrollerViewport, MessageScrollerContent, MessageScrollerItem, MessageScrollerButton } from "@/components/ui/manga/message-scroller"

<MessageScrollerProvider>
  <MessageScroller className="h-80">
    <MessageScrollerViewport>
      <MessageScrollerContent>
        <MessageScrollerItem>…</MessageScrollerItem>
      </MessageScrollerContent>
    </MessageScrollerViewport>
    <MessageScrollerButton />
  </MessageScroller>
</MessageScrollerProvider>

props.name: direction
props.description: Which way the button jumps: to the latest line or to the first.
